name: sealpost

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @sealpost/core && npm run build -w @sealpost/react && npm run build -w @sealpost/sdk
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:studio && npm run build -w @sealpost/cli
scripts.test: npm run test -w @sealpost/core && npm run test -w @sealpost/sdk && npm run test -w @sealpost/cli
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck -w @sealpost/core && npm run typecheck -w @sealpost/sdk && npm run typecheck -w @sealpost/cli
scripts.ci: npm run build:packages && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run smoke

description: Self-hosted email for developers: design emails visually, catch deliverability problems before sending, and deliver with real DKIM signing over plain SMTP. A zero-dependency alternative to Resend.
